execution.chargeBasis: No provider or model calls. Total execution charge is unknown.
execution.clientCallBasis: clientCalls counts registered probes; totalClientCalls also includes admin snapshots.

manifest.fixtureStatus: Public scripted development cases, not held-out evaluation.
manifest.clock: Grant expiry and revocation use central SQLite event order; elapsedMs is monotonic wall duration.
manifest.identity: TLS-verified client certificate DER SHA256 mapped to a server-configured principal.
manifest.authority: Synthetic local grant registry; no signed grant protocol or AGNTCY SDK.
manifest.sampling: Fixed requests; fresh ephemeral RSA certificates and TLS randomness each suite.
manifest.comparison: 14 enforced API cases and 5 deliberately corrupted recordings; no model comparison.
manifest.isolation: Separate same-OS-user service; not a malicious-process sandbox or OS-enforced egress isolation.
manifest.verification: Fresh local execution and deterministic-record comparison; omits time, environment and raw PIDs. Review excluded from source hashes to avoid a circular receipt.
